title: Library of Parliament
scope: The standing Library of Parliament conservation exterior at the north end of Centre Block, including its distinct 16-sided rotunda and the short mapped entrance extension.
limitations: The original library rotunda and its immediately attached connector are modeled as their own exterior. Centre Block, Peace Tower and temporary rehabilitation equipment remain outside this scope.
The native outline controls location and width. The height to the finial uses the OSM survey tag as an estimate. Carved tracery, individual sculptures and secondary roof dimensions are simplified.
The 1877 engraving informs the surviving masonry details. The modeled roof is modern copper with green patina, following the federal heritage description.
